query:
SELECT 
  empresaSlug,
  COUNT(DISTINCT data) as dias_lancados,
  SUM(cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8) as total_realizado,
  ROUND(SUM(cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8) / COUNT(DISTINCT data), 2) as media_diaria,
  ROUND(SUM(cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8) / COUNT(DISTINCT data) * 4, 2) as projecao_4_dias,
  ROUND(SUM(cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8) / COUNT(DISTINCT data) * 5, 2) as projecao_5_dias
FROM faturamentos 
WHERE data >= '2026-05-01' AND data <= '2026-05-31'
GROUP BY empresaSlug
ORDER BY empresaSlug;
